scope: CPU only; fixed existing scores and all eligible exposures; new metric families are exploratory; no training/model changes. Mixed requests contain both observed positive and observed negative labels. Request metric random baselines condition on actual slate n,m. User means weight active eligible users equally. Global top-fraction precision is offline pooled-budget ranking, not per-request serving quality. ROC TPR operating points and partial AUC are descriptive test curves, not prefit deployable thresholds. PR random baseline is population prevalence rather than finite-sample empirical AP expectation.
